section: Iterate — change: accept 5 security scan findings with written reasons
title: Record accepted-risk entries for the security scan in .gitleaksignore and .trivyignore
context: First trustworthy local OSS scan found a historical Supabase anon-key JWT and 4 medium CVEs (react-router x2, glob, minimatch). Each fix needs a major upgrade; the operator reviewed reachability and chose to accept.
decision: Suppress each finding by exact identifier with a written reachability statement: gitleaks by full fingerprint, Trivy by CVE id with exp:2027-05-01 in the flat .trivyignore that both the local scan and CI load. No workflow change.
consequences: Local scan reports 0 findings with all classes covered, so the Security dimension becomes measurable. The entries resurface on 2027-05-01. Trivy matches by id across packages, so reviewers must recheck which package an id hits.
rationale: No finding is reachable in this client-only SPA; the upgrades (react-router 7, glob 14, minimatch 11) carry more risk than the issues.
rejected: Major upgrades now; .trivyignore.yaml with package scoping (CI would need a workflow change to load it); leaving findings open.
